# smallstep_vpn (Data Source)

Configuration to use a credential to connect a device to a VPN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "smallstep_vpn" "my_vpn" {
  id = "ae1fe46c-3a74-4970-8e4e-263a9a889afb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of this protected VPN configuration.

### Read-Only

- `autojoin` (Boolean) Whether or not clients should automatically connect to the network.
- `connection_type` (String) The type of VPN connection. Allowed values: `IPsec` `IKEv2` `SSL`
- `credentials` (Set of String) The UUID of credentials that the Smallstep agent will configure to use this VPN integration.
- `ike` (Attributes) Configuration for VPNs that use the IKEv2 protocol. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ike))
- `name` (String) A human-friendly display name for this configuration.
- `remote_address` (String) The public IP address of the VPN server.
- `vendor` (String) For SSL-type VPN connections, the vendor of the VPN. Allowed values: `F5` `Cisco` `Juniper`

<a id="nestedatt--ike"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ike`

Read-Only:

- `ca_chain` (String) The certificate authority bundle that client certificates must chain up to.
- `eap` (Boolean) Whether or not EAP is enforced on this VPN server.
- `remote_id` (String) Typically, the common name of the remote server. Defaults to the remote address.
